title: Store error strings (rusqlite messages with schema/path details) returned verbatim to peer callers
description: kith-chat/src/lib.rs kith_to_jmap() and kith-peer/src/lib.rs (lines 172,183,195,207,226,255,265,281,384,408,424,430) pass raw KithError::Display output into JmapError::server_fail(). Rusqlite error messages routinely include table names, column names, constraint names, SQL fragments, and file paths (e.g. 'UNIQUE constraint failed: contacts.user_id', 'unable to open database file: /home/user/.kithd/kith.db'). These are returned in the JMAP description field to authenticated callers including peers. Fix: in kith_to_jmap and all JmapError::server_fail() call sites in kith-peer, log the error internally and return a fixed string 'internal error' to the caller.
